# About the Mod

## This is not just another Minecraft mod.
It is a "what if I had influence over the evolution of the game" kind of modification.

Although still in development, this mod aims to deeply rework Minecraft, making it more challenging, more rewarding, and ultimately more enjoyable.
Progression is slower, items are more valuable, and every achievement feels earned.

### New Decorative Blocks & Items

The mod introduces many new decorative blocks and variants, giving builders far more creative freedom.
Blocks such as Azurite, Granite Bricks, Diorite Tiles, Statues, new flowers, and new plants allow players to create richer, more detailed worlds than ever before.
![Flowers](https://cdn.phototourl.com/uploads/2026-02-15-7e435c38-71eb-401f-acdb-35d4a5bea154.png)
![new decorative blocks](https://cdn.phototourl.com/uploads/2026-02-15-75ac8e5c-4f03-454c-bb5f-01e1b2ee9baa.png)
### Backpacks

Balanced backpacks are added to the game.
They do not replace pouches or shulker boxes, but instead complement early-game inventory management.
Backpacks are easy to obtain at the beginning, allowing players to carry more blocks without breaking game balance.

### New Weapons

New weapons with unique mechanics are introduced, such as:

- Halberds, capable of knocking players off horses
- Chain Maces, which can temporarily stun enemies
- Each weapon has a distinct role and changes how combat is approached.
- A Completely New Tool & Armor Progression System
![New Armors and weapons](https://cdn.phototourl.com/uploads/2026-02-15-c7d4a22e-4f05-402f-bcae-a14f34f1ae6b.png)

You no longer craft diamond tools directly.

Instead, progression follows a clear path:
Copper → Iron → Steel → Diamond → Netherite
![Tool and Armor Upgrade Tree](https://cdn.phototourl.com/uploads/2026-02-15-47c31c5e-06e4-4ed5-af88-b41cc1f308c3.png)

Each upgrade requires effort, exploration, and resources.
Tools and armor become far more valuable, making the game significantly harder and more rewarding.
(After all, in vanilla Minecraft, diamond gear can be obtained in under 30 minutes.)

### New Structures & Loot Crates

The world now contains new structures and multiple types of loot crates, each offering unique rewards.
Exploration is more meaningful and consistently rewarding.

### New Rarity System

All items are now classified by rarity:
Common, Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare, Epic, Legendary
This system improves clarity, progression, and overall game feel.
![Rarity](https://cdn.phototourl.com/uploads/2026-02-15-47c7cba3-0e41-4a38-ae6c-a29a40ada11c.png)
![Rarity](https://cdn.phototourl.com/uploads/2026-02-15-15f32ac0-5d6e-4dd3-bf0b-7800e1c53fdd.png)

### In-Game Guide Books

Every player receives several guide books explaining the new mechanics in detail.
Thanks to clear documentation, even new players will not feel lost.
The mod is designed to be complex, yet beginner-friendly.

### New Crops & Farming

New crops include:
Chili Peppers, Bell Peppers, Strawberries, Tomatoes, Onions, Rice
Because in Minecraft - there is never enough farming content.
Premium Food & Advanced Cooking System (Work in Progress)
A brand-new cooking system is being developed.
In addition to regular food, players can prepare premium meals that grant positive effects, but require more effort and ingredients.

## And That’s Not All…

### This description only scratches the surface.
Want to discover everything this mod has to offer?
